main_content: The Blount Chamber, a nonpartisan organization, welcomes you to the voters' resource page for Blount County elections. Here, you can view the candidates running for office during the November 3 election. This includes federal/state general election for governor, U.S. Senator, U.S. House of Representatives (District 2), TN House of Representatives (District 8 and 20), State Executive Committeeman (1 Republican and 1 Democrat), State Executive Committeewoman (1 Republican and 1 Democrat). Municipal general election is being held for Alcoa City Council (3 seats), Alcoa City School Board (3 seats), Louisville City Mayor, Louisville City Alderman (2 seats), Maryville City Council (3 seats), Maryville City School Board (3 seats).

important_dates.description: Last day to register to vote for the November 3 election.
